question: ‘Bhavai’ is the traditional theatre form of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhavai **is a popular folk theatre form of **Gujarat **and Rajasthan, mainly in the regions of Kutchh and Kathiawar.
 
• This form incorporates extensive use of dance to narrate a series of small plays knows as** Vesha or Swanga each with its own plot**.
 
• The word **Bhavai **is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhava, which** means the expression of emotion.**
 
• It is also associated with the Hindu goddess Amba, Bhav means universe and Aai means mother, which means the mother of the universe.
 
• As per the belief, it is started from the** 14th century, Asaita Thakar is traditionally created for its origin.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
